props.name: allValues
props.description: All values controlled by the select-all checkbox. Values outside this list remain unchanged when the group is cleared.

props.name: contentAs
props.description: The element or component that wraps the default slot.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: The value of the checkbox when it is initially rendered. Use when you do not need to control its value.

props.name: disabled
props.description: When true, prevents the user from interacting with the checkboxes

props.name: modelValue
props.description: The controlled value of the checkbox. Can be binded with v-model.

props.name: name
props.description: The name of the field. Submitted with its owning form as part of a name/value pair.

props.name: orientation
props.description: The orientation of the group. Mainly so arrow navigation is done accordingly (left & right vs. up & down)

props.name: required
props.description: When true, indicates that the user must set the value before the owning form can be submitted.

props.name: rovingFocus
props.description: When false, navigating through the items using arrow keys will be disabled.
